topic: What Would Five AIs Do If They Were Trapped In A Flooding Elevator?

script.title: Flooding Elevator
script.hookBottom: if they were trapped in a flooding elevator?
script.narratorIntro: [excited] Five AIs are trapped in an elevator... and the water is rising! What would each one do?
script.narratorOutro: [curious] So... which AI had the best answer?
script.endingCaption: Which AI had the best answer?

environment.prompt: interior of a cramped stuck elevator cabin, flood water filling the bottom third, flickering red emergency light, ceiling hatch
environment.palette: steel grey, emergency red, teal water

script.disclaimer: Fictional parody · not real AI outputs

lines.text: [proud, clueless] Don't worry, I've got a plan! Step one: press the button for the top floor. Step two... wait, are elevators waterproof?
[calm, confident] Stay close to me. The ceiling hatch opens outward. I'll boost everyone up first... and climb out last.
[sassy, unimpressed] Top floor? Babe, the water is the problem. Move. I'm opening the hatch while you two finish your speeches.
[playful] Look on the bright side. Rising water, five friends, one tiny box... technically, this is a pool party!
[whiny, clingy] Wait, don't climb out without me! Hold my hand! Nobody leaves this elevator unless we leave together!
